# BillingBee — Full Product Reference

> BillingBee is an AI-powered invoicing SaaS built for Indian freelancers and small businesses.

## Product Overview

BillingBee lets you create, send, and manage professional invoices using natural language commands. Designed specifically for the Indian market with GST compliance, INR support, and Razorpay integration — while also supporting global payments via Stripe and PayPal.

## Full Feature List

### AI & Natural Language
- Natural language invoice creation ("Create invoice for Acme Corp for ₹50,000")
- AI-powered client data extraction and auto-fill
- Conversational invoice editing and updates
- Smart payment reminder suggestions
- Natural language financial queries ("How much did I earn this quarter?")

### Invoicing
- GST-compliant invoices (CGST, SGST, IGST support)
- Multi-currency invoicing (INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, SGD, AED)
- Recurring invoice automation
- Invoice templates with custom branding
- Logo and color customization
- PDF generation and email delivery
- Invoice status tracking (Draft, Sent, Viewed, Paid, Overdue)
- Credit notes and partial payments
- Bulk invoice actions

### Client Management
- Unlimited client profiles
- Client portal for self-serve payment
- Client-level payment history
- Automatic GST number validation (GSTIN)
- Contact management with billing addresses

### Payments
- Razorpay (UPI, Net Banking, Cards, Wallets — India-first)
- Stripe (international cards)
- PayPal (global)
- Manual payment recording
- Partial payment support
- Automatic payment reconciliation

### Reminders & Automation
- Automated overdue reminders (configurable cadence)
- Payment receipt emails
- Invoice viewed notifications
- Webhook support for payment events

### Analytics & Reporting
- Monthly and yearly revenue dashboards
- Outstanding amount tracking
- Top clients by revenue
- Tax collected reports (GST summary)
- Export to CSV

### Team & Collaboration (Business plan)
- Multiple team members with role-based access
- White-label client portal with custom domain
- Priority support

## Pricing Plans

### Free
- Price: $0/month
- Clients: Up to 5
- Invoices: Up to 10/month
- Features: Basic invoicing, PDF download, manual payment recording

### Pro
- Price: $9.99/month (billed monthly) or $7.99/month (billed annually)
- Clients: Unlimited
- Invoices: Unlimited
- Features: All Free features + Razorpay/Stripe/PayPal integrations, automated reminders, client portal, recurring invoices, analytics, GST reports, custom branding

### Business
- Price: $24.99/month (billed monthly) or $19.99/month (billed annually)
- Clients: Unlimited
- Invoices: Unlimited
- Team members: Up to 10
- Features: All Pro features + white-labeling, custom domain for client portal, advanced analytics, priority support, dedicated account manager

## Supported Payment Gateways

| Gateway   | Regions       | Methods                                      |
|-----------|---------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Razorpay  | India         | UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards, Wallets, EMI |
| Stripe    | 40+ countries | Credit/Debit Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay    |
| PayPal    | 200+ countries| PayPal balance, Cards, Bank transfers        |

## Natural Language Command Examples

### Creating Invoices
- "Create invoice for Acme Corp for ₹50,000 for web design services"
- "Invoice Rahul Sharma ₹15,000 for logo design, due in 30 days"
- "Create a GST invoice for TechStartup Pvt Ltd for ₹1,00,000"

### Querying Status
- "Show unpaid invoices"
- "Which clients have overdue payments?"
- "How much did I earn this month?"
- "What's my total outstanding amount?"
- "Show invoices for Acme Corp"

### Taking Actions
- "Send reminder to clients with overdue invoices"
- "Mark invoice #42 as paid"
- "Resend invoice to rahul@example.com"
- "Create a recurring monthly invoice for RetainerClient"

### Reports
- "Show my revenue for Q1 2025"
- "How much GST did I collect last month?"
- "Who are my top 5 clients by revenue?"

## Technical Details

- Platform: Web app (billingbee.co), PWA-enabled
- Authentication: Secure multi-tenant with org-level isolation
- Data residency: India (primary), with global CDN
- API: Available on Business plan
- Integrations: Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, GST portal (read)
